messages:
meera: heads-up — support just flagged that the incident bot posted to #incidents for svc-model-prod but the PD page didn't go out to the rotation. I can see the thread here but no ack/phone logs. anyone else seeing this? :warning:
ops-bot: Automation: incident created (svc-model-prod) -> routing policy 'primary-rotation'. Webhook delivered to PagerDuty: 200 OK. PagerDuty response body: {\"status\":\"suppressed\"} (no incident created).
meera: interesting, webhook 200 but PD says suppressed. could this be a suppression rule on PD side? eli you oncall?
pagerduty-bot: Event processed. Triggered events: 0. Suppression reason: 'auto-suppression: on-call-suppression-policy'.
eli: thanks — i'm oncall. i'm not seeing a phone page. can someone manually page the rotation while we triage? i'll take post-detection steps.
alex: manual page sent to rotation via PD UI (incident created). eli: did that come through?
eli: yep manual page just hit my phone. I'm up. :thumbsup: Looks like the automation path is suppressed by a new PD policy that was added last week for low-severity incidents. This one classified as 'warning' by our bot.
sara: customer-impact check: are customers seeing errors or is this an internal only? support? @kira
kira: customer reports — a handful of 500s from inference nodes for a subset of requests since 05:12 UTC. Not widespread but affecting 3 customers (IDs redacted). Severity bumped.
meera: ok, escalation required. immediate mitigation: eli is oncall and manual page succeeded. we need to revert or bypass the suppression for automation.
alex: digging into the webhook payload we send to PD. I pulled the payload for the failed attempts, here's the important bits:
```
{
  "payload": {
    "summary": "svc-model-prod: high 5xx rate",
    "severity": "warning",
    "source": "redwood-incident-bot",
    "custom_details": { "error_rate": "0.07" }
  }
}
```
meera: PD suppression likely config'd to ignore 'warning' -> treat only 'critical' as actionable. that's new. we either bump severity in our bot for certain detection patterns or change PD suppression rules. which is quicker for live mitigation?
eli: quick path = change bot to send severity: critical for '>=5% 5xx over 5m' incidents. Alex can push a config change and we can toggle back after. longer term: revisit suppression policy.
alex: I can flip the severity mapping in the bot config and push a hotfix. pushing as a non-breaking config update now. patch in the rules service: `SEVERITY_MAP['error_rate>0.05'] = 'critical'`
ops-bot: Deploy started by alex (deploy/patch/severity-bump) — build 452.
meera: while that's in flight, can someone confirm PD logs for the earlier webhook calls? paste response body / headers if possible.
alex: copied recent responses:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{"status":"suppressed","reason":"suppression_rule_id:sr_42"}
```
eli: sr_42 is 'low-noise-window' suppression rule that product enabled last week. @sara can you confirm if that rule was intended to block automation?
sara: that was meant for background metrics-only alerts, not for incident-bot. looks like filter conditions were too broad. I opened PD ticket PD-987 to discuss. For now, approve hotfix to bot mapping.
ops-bot: Deploy succeeded (build 452) — restart of incident-bot service on prod nodes completed.
alex: test webhook now (sending synthetic incident):
```
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"payload":{"summary":"test","severity":"critical","source":"redwood-incident-bot"}}' https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue
```
ops-bot: PagerDuty response: 201 Created, incident key: inc_0xyz. Manual page triggered.
eli: confirmed phone page for test. Good. Now re-run the detection for the real signal to make sure it pages.
meera: re-evaluating customer impact — support says error rate has fallen after small hotfix to inference fleet at 05:26 UTC but still recurring for some requests. we should notify affected customers and track SLA exposure. sara, can you own comms?
sara: will draft customer note, linking incident timeline and mitigations. tagging CSMs.
kira: adding affected customer IDs to the incident doc and starting tickets.
meera: follow-ups: 1) PD suppression rule sr_42 needs to be scoped narrower (sara to follow up with PD admins) 2) Add unit tests that validate our PD payload severity mapping (alex) 3) Add monitoring alert if bot's pages_count < expected_pages_count for 10m (meera) 4) Post-incident review + retro (eli)
eli: I'll own postmortem, will collect logs and timeline.
meera: thanks everyone. adding Jira PD-987 and INCF-202 to track. marking this thread resolved for live paging — manual page worked and hotfix restored automation. Will leave this thread open for postmortem notes and timeline additions. :white_check_mark:
